ideas.title: Investigation into Federal Agents Under Investigation
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent revelations of federal agents lying under oath and making false statements. It would examine the extent of the problem and the potential consequences for those involved.
questions: What is the extent of the problem of federal agents lying under oath?
What are the potential consequences for those involved?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a significant scandal and hold those in power accountable. It requires careful investigation and analysis of the facts to determine the extent of the problem and the potential consequences.
